title: Bundled profinite component space of an affine scheme
statement: For an affine scheme $T$ [def-pc-scheme], define $P(T)$ to be the quotient of its underlying topological space by equality of connected components, equipped with the quotient topology. Bundle this topological space as a profinite space, using the compactness, Hausdorffness and total disconnectedness of the component quotient of a spectral space [lem-pe-spectral-components-profinite]. Its points and topology are literally this quotient, and the canonical map sends $x\in T$ to its component. This includes the empty scheme.
